public_rationale: Capacity pressure is documented for both companies, so the antecedent has occurred. The retrieved evidence does not establish the predicted response by both. OpenAI's contributor distinguishes a capacity shortage from rate limiting. Anthropic documents a quality regression and reversal without establishing a capacity-driven cause. These records do not show degradation 'as much as they can,' and no decisive event closes the forecast.
limitations: Company explanations are not independent measurements of quality.
The maximality phrase lacks an operational threshold.
A temporary failure and a deliberate allowance reduction are different events.
Some restrictions discussed in later reporting originated before the post.

public_payload.normalized_proposition: As capacity limits are hit, Anthropic and OpenAI will degrade user experience as much as they can via model degradation or rate limits.

statement.excerpt: In fact, I think that as capacity limits get hit, both Anthropic and OpenAI will degrade the experience for the user (either through model degradation or rate limit decay) as much as they can.
statement.document_title: I Will Never Respect A Website

from_speaker: model degradation or rate limit decay
our_interpretation: Capacity limits means insufficient serving capacity for demand, not a customer's exhaustion of an existing allowance.
The ordinary testable core is that each company responds to capacity pressure by reducing model quality or allowed usage.
Temporary errors or an unrelated software regression do not by themselves establish the predicted response.
Retain the maximality assertion as an additional requirement; evidence of any deterioration alone cannot establish 'as much as they can'.
criteria.support_condition: For both companies, verified capacity constraints are followed by attributable reductions in model quality or usage allowances, with evidence supporting the claimed extent of those reductions.
criteria.contradiction_condition: A well-documented completed response to capacity pressure preserves or improves quality and allowances despite feasible reductions, undermining the asserted response. An unrelated improvement after capacity expands is not sufficient.

evidence.locator: Exploding demand amid constrained compute supply
evidence.explanation: This contemporaneous account describes Anthropic's capacity pressure. It establishes the condition but does not date every restriction after the forecast or establish maximal degradation.
The contributor identifies a regional model-capacity shortage. The surrounding response distinguishes this from exhausting usage or being rate limited.

Anthropic acknowledges a post-publication quality regression but says it reversed the change. This cautions against treating any observed deterioration as evidence of a capacity-driven policy of maximal degradation.

public_payload.what_would_resolve: Dated evidence connecting each company's capacity constraints to subsequent quality or allowance decisions, with controlled measurements and evidence of the choices available to it. A defined scope for the maximality assertion would also be needed for full support.
